about:
eBay is an online marketplace that connect millions of sellers and buyers in more than 190 markets around the world.

eBay Connector enables streaming relevant eBay data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.

You can find more information on [eBay documentation page](https://developer.ebay.com/api-docs/static/ebay-rest-landing.html).
